benchmark_name: Smart Maintenance Assistant — RAG Eval Set v1

questions.question: What vibration level is critical for Pump-3?
questions.gold_answer: Critical vibration for Pump-3 is above 7.0 mm/s RMS — reduce load immediately and plan bearing replacement within 24 hours.

questions.question: What is the warning vibration range for Pump-3, and when should inspection be scheduled?
questions.gold_answer: Warning level is 4.5–7.0 mm/s RMS; schedule inspection within 72 hours.

questions.question: What bearing housing temperature is critical for Pump-3?
questions.gold_answer: Critical bearing housing temperature is above 80°C — stop the pump if process allows and verify cooling and bearing condition.

questions.question: What indicates high bearing failure risk for Pump-3 within 7 days?
questions.gold_answer: High risk when ALL are true: vibration above 6.5 mm/s for 3+ consecutive readings, bearing temperature above 75°C, and hours since last service exceed 800.

questions.question: When should I replace HVAC Unit-7 filters?
questions.gold_answer: Replace filters when differential pressure exceeds 1.2 inches w.c., or typically every 90 days under normal occupancy.

questions.question: What should I do if HVAC Unit-7 motor current exceeds 20A?
questions.gold_answer: Sustained current above 20 A is a warning — inspect filters, belts, and coil fouling. Critical is above 24 A or repeated VFD overcurrent trips.

questions.question: What supply-to-return air temperature difference indicates a cooling problem on HVAC Unit-7?
questions.gold_answer: If delta-T drops below 8°C for more than 48 hours, inspect refrigerant charge and coil cleanliness. Normal cooling delta-T is 13–16°C.

questions.question: What are the critical vibration and bearing temperature limits for plant electric motors?
questions.gold_answer: Per the motor manual: vibration critical is >7.1 mm/s; bearing temperature critical is >85°C.

questions.question: What grease type should be used for electric motor bearings, and what is the risk of over-greasing?
questions.gold_answer: Use lithium complex grease NLGI Grade 2 (LUB-G2-LC). Over-greasing is a leading cause of bearing failure; purge old grease through the relief plug.

questions.question: What indicates high bearing failure risk and when should a bearing be replaced rather than monitored?
questions.gold_answer: Replace if vibration is rising >10% per week, temperature exceeds critical threshold, or there is visible spalling, noise, or play. Monitor if vibration is stable and below warning with normal temperature.

questions.question: What is the normal discharge pressure range for plant air compressors AC-1 through AC-3?
questions.gold_answer: Normal discharge pressure is 6.8–7.2 bar.

questions.question: At what oil iron (Fe) level should compressor internal wear be investigated?
questions.gold_answer: Iron (Fe) above 50 ppm indicates internal wear — borescope investigation.

questions.question: What is the maximum allowed belt mistrack on the conveyor systems?
questions.gold_answer: Maximum belt mistrack is 25 mm from center at any point.

questions.question: When should conveyor idlers be replaced?
questions.gold_answer: Replace idlers for visual flat spots or seized rotation, shell wear >3 mm, or noise on rotation hand test.

questions.question: What are the seven steps of the site lockout/tagout procedure EHS-LOTO-001?
questions.gold_answer: Notify personnel; shut down; isolate energy; apply locks/tags; release stored energy; verify zero energy; perform work.

questions.question: Who may authorize emergency removal of a LOTO lock, and what form is used?
questions.gold_answer: Only the plant manager may authorize emergency lock removal. Document on form LOTO-EMR-01.

questions.question: What are the PdM alert response SLAs for critical and high severity alerts?
questions.gold_answer: Critical: 4 hours. High: 24 hours. Medium: 72 hours. Low: next scheduled window.

questions.question: According to the vibration handbook severity chart, what mm/s RMS range is unsatisfactory and requires planned repair?
questions.gold_answer: 7.1–18 mm/s RMS is unsatisfactory — plan repair. Above 18 is unacceptable — consider shutdown.

questions.question: What does fault code VIB-CRIT-01 mean in the condition monitoring system?
questions.gold_answer: VIB-CRIT-01 means vibration exceeded critical threshold (variant 1), typically handled as a PdM work order within 24–72 hours per severity.

questions.question: Which site LOTO standard must maintenance follow for OSHA 1910.147 compliance?
questions.gold_answer: Full compliance with site standard EHS-LOTO-001, with annual audit and training documented.
